attchmntText: Shalimar Paints Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of 51948051 securities pursuant to Qualified Institution Placement at its meeting held on November 20, 2026
voiceSummary: Shalimar Paints Limited has allotted 5,19,48,051 equity shares at Rs. 77 per share, aggregating to Rs. 3,99,99,99,927. This Qualified Institutions Placement closed on November 20, 2026. The issue price represents a discount of approximately 4.785% to the floor price of Rs. 80.87. The company's paid-up equity share capital increases from 8,37,11,178 shares to 13,56,59,229 shares. Major allottees include Venus Investments VCC with 17.50% of the issue size, Altitude Investment Fund with 13.75%, and Rigel Global Fund with 12.50%. These top three investors hold a combined 43.75% of the allotted shares. The allotment was approved by the QIP Committee on November 20, 2026. Previous approvals were granted by the Board on August 12, 2026, and by shareholders on September 11, 2026.

attchmntText: SRF Limited has informed the Exchange about Action(s) taken or orders passed
voiceSummary: SRF Limited disclosed receipt of an Order-in-Original from the Office of the Commissioner of Customs, NS II – Nhava Sheva Port on 20.11.2026 at 09.11 a.m. The Customs Authority imposed a redemption fine of Rs. 15 lakh under Section 125 of the Customs Act, 1962, and a penalty of Rs. 7 lakh under Section 114(iii) of the Customs Act, 1962. The order rejects RoDTEP benefits claimed by the company on certain export products totaling Rs. 17,01,701. The authority considered these products ineligible because the requisite Export Authorisation or NOC was not established for the relevant consignments. SRF Limited states it intends to contest the order before the appropriate appellate or legal forum. The company asserts the order is not legally sustainable and believes there is no material impact on its operations or other activities.
